items.title: LVMH's OpenAI Media Deal Lands as Armani Talks End and Paris Backs Vuitton Flagship Financing
items.why: LVMH has struck a media deal with OpenAI, talks involving Armani have ended, and Paris is backing financing for a Vuitton flagship.
